question: The value of (3 div 3 times 2-6 div 3+7)/(5 div 5 times 6 div 6+3+3) is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

The expression is (3 ÷ 3 × 2 - 6 ÷ 3 + 7) / (5 ÷ 5 × 6 ÷ 6 + 3 + 3).

**Formula Used:**

Order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS): Parentheses/Brackets, Exponents/Orders (i.e., powers and square roots, etc.), Multiplication and Division (left-to-right), Addition and Subtraction (left-to-right).

**Calculation:**

⇒ (3 ÷ 3 × 2 - 6 ÷ 3 + 7) / (5 ÷ 5 × 6 ÷ 6 + 3 + 3)

⇒ (1 × 2 - 2 + 7) / (1 × 1 + 3 + 3)

⇒ (2 - 2 + 7) / (1 + 3 + 3)

⇒ 7 / 7

⇒ 1

**The value of the given expression is 1.**
